fact.title: Variable pay and CTC structure are set by contract
fact.claim: Variable pay is contractual. Your employer cannot change a pay term without your consent.
fact.caveat: Read how your offer letter defines variable pay.

script.cover_1: The variable part of your pay shrank. Nobody asked you.
script.payoff: Reports say a pay term cannot change without your consent.
script.caption: Pay terms live in your offer letter, not in someone's memory. Send this to the friend whose variable pay keeps moving.
script.situation: Can your company cut your variable pay without asking you?
script.answer: Reports say variable pay is contractual, and a pay term cannot change without your consent.
script.reply_me: Could you share in writing why my variable pay changed? My offer letter lists the earlier terms.
